title.narrative: Providing life-saving and life-sustaining Protection (GBV) interventions in hard-to-reach areas in As-Sweida and Aleppo governorates.

description.narrative: ltpgtThe project implements comprehensive GBV interventions in the underserved areas of As-Sweida and Aleppo governorates. NCA’s GBV/CVA informs the activity design needs assessments conducted in July 2024 (Annex 11 21) and February 2025, as well as a multi-sectoral assessment by GOPA/DERD in May 2024 (Annex 12). Findings were further validated through coordination with the GBV Sub-Sector, local stakeholders, and other organizations.lt/pgtltpgtThe project was initially implemented in Milh (As-Sweida), where services were delivered for several months. However, due to ongoing access and security constraints, continuation in Milh became unfeasible. Accordingly, during the NCE period, activities will be shifted to Sweida City (As-Sweida) while continuing in Jebel Saman (Aleppo), ensuring continuity of GBV services in SHF-prioritized locations.lt/pgtltpgtNCA’s interventions align with OCHA’s Strategic Priority 1, focusing on life-saving and life-sustaining GBV services in Sweida City and Aleppo City. Services will be delivered through GOPA/DERD in As-Sweida and EPDC in Rural Aleppo, both of which operate established Women and Girls Safe Spaces (WGSS) and family centers that serve as hubs for outreach and mobile services to underserved communities.ltbrgtThe project will leverage the expertise of trained partner staff, complemented by ongoing capacity building to ensure quality service delivery. Strong community trust and longstanding partner presence are key enablers for effective interventions.ltbrgtOutcome 1 will deliver essential GBV response services, including case management, CVA, referrals, structured psychosocial support, and MHPSS.ltbrgtOutcome 2 will focus on prevention through community-based outreach and awareness-raising to reduce risks, advocate for women’s and girls’ rights, and challenge harmful gender norms.lt/pgt
